Mario Cibelli increased its stake in Hd Supply Hldgs Inc (HDS) by 4.23% based on its latest 2018Q1 regulatory filing with the SEC. The hedge fund run by Mario Cibelli held 740,000 shares of the consumer services company at the end of 2018Q1, valued at $28.08 million, up from 710,000 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Marathon Partners Equity Management Llc who had been investing in Hd Supply Hldgs Inc for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $7.84 billion market cap company.
